name: Emery
description: The Emery was one of three StoneCrusher-class WarMasters that served in the fleet of the Grysk operative "Jixtus." Around 18 BBY, the StoneCrusher engaged a group of forces of the Chiss and Paccosh species over the planet Sunrise in the Sunrise system. While engaging the Chiss heavy cruiser Grayshrike, its engines were destroyed, and the Emery exploded.
